purpose_context: muster-action currently forwards only the A2A endpoint/token pair; a caller can already leak MUSTER_API_KEY through inherited job env, but there is no documented, guarded input surface for the general behavioral env vars (MUSTER_ENDPOINT/MUSTER_MODEL/MUSTER_API_KEY) that muster's skills/sop/crosslayer adapters read. This mission adds that surface with the same empty-unset discipline the A2A inputs already have, documents the fork-PR/missing-secret behavior, and ships the CI-side answer to muster having no xfail mechanism: a fail-on:never step plus an explicit assertion that a discrimination control's result is 'failed', because a naive exit-0-is-green mapping would be wrong for exactly the manifests this mission cares about.
purpose_tldr: Add a supported model-endpoint/model/api-key input surface to muster-action, with the empty-must-be-unset guard and the CI control-inversion pattern for discrimination controls.
